summary.text: Kelda Roys is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 26, based in Madison, and was elected to the Senate in 2020.
She served in the Assembly from 2008 to 2010 and sits on the Finance and Judiciary and Public Safety committees.

paragraphs.text: Roys was born in Marshfield, Wisconsin, on June 24, 1979, and is married with three children and two stepchildren.
She earned a B.A. in drama, politics and cultural studies, magna cum laude, from New York University in 2000 and a J.D., magna cum laude, from the University of Wisconsin Law School in 2004.
The Legislature's page lists her as an attorney and small business owner and a former nonprofit executive.
It says she was elected to the Assembly for 2008-2010, served as minority caucus chair in 2011, and was elected to the Senate in 2020.
She is a member of the Clean Lakes Alliance board and the State Bar of Wisconsin, and a former board member of the ACLU of Wisconsin and Common Cause of Wisconsin.
